name: Sultopride
summary: Sultopride, sold under the brand name Barnetil among others, is an antipsychotic medication of the benzamide chemical class used in Europe, Japan, and Hong Kong for the treatment of schizophrenia. It was launched by Sanofi-Aventis in 1976. Sultopride acts as a selective D2 and D3 receptor antagonist.

pharmacology.text: Sultopride acts as a selective D2 and D3 receptor antagonist. It has also been shown to have clinically relevant affinity for the GHB receptor as well, a property it shares in common with amisulpride and sulpiride.

uses.text: Sultopride, sold under the brand name Barnetil among others, is an antipsychotic medication of the benzamide chemical class used in Europe, Japan, and Hong Kong for the treatment of schizophrenia.

sideEffects.en: Like other drugs that block D2 receptors, it can cause stiffness, tremor, restlessness and raised prolactin. Sultopride is known for a higher risk of dangerous heart rhythm problems than related benzamides.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他阻斷D2受體的藥物一樣，它可能造成肌肉僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安與泌乳激素升高。相較於同類的苯甲醯胺藥物，它引發危險心律問題的風險較高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他阻断D2受体的药物一样，它可能造成肌肉僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安与泌乳激素升高。相较于同类的苯甲酰胺药物，它引发危险心律问题的风险较高。

fact.en: Sultopride belongs to the benzamide family of antipsychotics, along with sulpiride and amisulpride. It was launched in 1976 and has been used in Europe, Japan and Hong Kong.
fact.zh: Sultopride與舒必利、胺磺必利同屬苯甲醯胺類抗精神病藥。它在1976年上市，曾在歐洲、日本與香港使用。
fact.zhHans: Sultopride与舒必利、胺磺必利同属苯甲酰胺类抗精神病药。它在1976年上市，曾在欧洲、日本与香港使用。
